messages:
devon: quick sync — postmortem action items for session-stitching, partial-chunk detection, and reconnect logic. who wants to grab ownership + ETAs?
sarah: i'll own partial-chunk detection. plan is to add a Prometheus metric + Grafana alert. ETA: end of week.
ajay: i'll take the reconnection policy refactor (handshake/backoff state machine). aiming for next Wed to open the PR.
irene: devon, can you own session-stitching (idempotent resume + prefix cache)? that's the thing customers hit when they see partial responses.
devon: yep i'll take session-stitching. plan: add session_id resume tokens, implement a resume window, and build a small harness to replay interrupted sessions. ETA: 2 weeks.
ops-bot: incident ticket created: INC-4592 — https://tickets/INC-4592 (autocreated from postmortem actions)
sarah: for alerts i'm proposing a `partial_response_rate` metric (1m window) with threshold 0.5% -> page SRE. thoughts?
ajay: that sounds good. i'll include a configurable circuit-breaker in the refactor and add exponential jitter. rough config sketch in PR:
```
handshake:
  max_attempts: 5
  base_backoff_ms: 200
  max_backoff_ms: 8000
```
mike: we should demo the harness + metrics in a 30m follow-up next Tue — customers want visible remediation steps.
devon: @mike added to calendar. also we need a clear rollback: fallback to a lower-latency model variant when resume fails repeatedly. i'll draft fallback flow.
irene: :thumbsup: please add owners + ETA to the ticket and a simple risk matrix (probability x customer impact). label with `stability, streaming`.
sarah: noted. i'll also attach an eval prompt set to catch regressions (short prompt that used to trigger partial-chunks).
ajay: one blocker: we need a flag to enable handshake logs. proposal: store in encrypted S3 bucket by default, 30d retention. ok with SRE?
devon: ok with S3 + 30d retention, add to runbook and cost note.
ops-bot: recurring cadence created: weekly check-in every Wed 10:00am for INC-4592 owners.
sarah: closing loop on my side: i'll ship the metric + alert by Fri. ping me if anything blocks.
ajay: i'll open the PR Monday EOD with design doc in #eng-runtime.
devon: tracking update: INC-4592 now has owners, timelines, and test criteria. i'll mark ready-for-demo when session resume tests pass.
